summary.en: After Punk: space, rhythmic experiment, art ambition.
summary.zh: Punk 之后的空间感、节奏实验与艺术野心。

body.en: Post-Punk keeps Punk's edge while reintroducing atmosphere, bass lines, and art-school experiment. It deeply shapes Alternative and contemporary Indie.
body.zh: Post-Punk 保留了 Punk 的锋利，却重新引入氛围、低音线条与艺术学院式实验。它深刻影响了 Alternative 与当代 Indie。
